packageRules.description: TypeScript 7: typescript-eslint peers on '>=4.8.4 <6.1.0' and hard-errors with 'typescript-eslint does not support TS 7.0'. tsc itself passes clean on 7.0.2 under Next 16 — only the lint toolchain blocks it. Track typescript-eslint#10940 and drop this rule when it ships TS 7 support.

ESLint 10: eslint-plugin-react 7.37.5 peers on '<=^9.7' and crashes on the removed context.getFilename API. eslint-config-next depends on it, so this unblocks only when that plugin ships ESLint 10 support.
@types/node tracks the Node major the Dockerfile actually runs (24 LTS), not the newest published types.
